name: slime-king-additional-cost-never-charged
notes:
Slime King (f0ymeslfpw, UNIQUE,ALLY): "As an additional cost to activate this card, banish three Slime ally cards each with different elements from your graveyard. Pride 4, Taunt. [Element Bonus] On Leave: You may put any number of the Slime ally cards banished by CARDNAME onto the field under your control." ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): this fixture documents the mandatory additional cost CURRENTLY never being charged at all, even with 3 legal (differently-elemented) Slime allies sitting in the graveyard -- Slime King materializes paying only its printed 3 reserve cost, with the graveyard left completely untouched.

Confirmed live with a standalone debug harness: with Red Slime (mttsvbgl6f, FIRE), Storm Slime (blqryebvwj, ARCANE), and Lustrous Slime (ejvddohjdu, LUXEM) seeded into the graveyard (3 differently-elemented Slime allies -- the exact precondition the card's own legality gate requires), playing Slime King from hand only ever queues the normal 3x 'ReserveCard' payment decisions; no 'SlimeKingCostBanish' MZCHOOSE/CUSTOM decision is ever queued, and after paying reserve the card lands on the field with all 3 graveyard cards still there and the Banish zone empty.

Root cause (read directly in source, not just inferred from the symptom): Custom/GameLogic.php's cost-declaration function declares `$hasSlimeKingCost = false;` (~line 2430) among dozens of sibling `$hasXCost` flags for other cards' additional costs -- but grep over the entire file finds NO `$hasSlimeKingCost = true;` assignment anywhere, unlike every sibling (e.g. Furnace Drone's analogous cost at ~line 2767 does `if($obj->CardID === "cbNF64gCsS" && !$ignoreCost) { ... $hasFurnaceDroneCost = true; ... }`). There is no equivalent `if($obj->CardID === "f0ymeslfpw" ...)` branch to ever flip the flag and queue the fully-written, otherwise-correct-looking `$customDQHandlers['SlimeKingCostBanish']` chain (Custom/GameLogic.php ~4347). The activateCardPrereqs legality gate (requiring >=3 differently-elemented graveyard Slime allies before the card can even be chosen to play) IS correctly wired and works -- only the matching cost-CHARGING branch was never added. This reads as a straightforward wiring omission (the generator/hand-author built the handler and the legality gate but never connected the cost-declaration trigger for it), not a fixture-authoring gap. Confidence: HIGH / directly confirmed -- both by reading the cost-declaration function end-to-end for a `$hasSlimeKingCost = true` assignment (none exists) and by live-replaying the exact precondition and observing the graveyard/banish/decision-queue state after the fact.

Slime King's element is TERA, not native to the 'Spirit of Fire' starting champion, so the champion's Subcards are patched with a real TERA champion (Kongming, Fel Eidolon) purely to unlock element access. This fixture pins the CURRENT (buggy, too-cheap) observed behavior as a regression baseline so a future fix is easy to spot (the assertions below will need updating once Slime King actually charges its printed cost). The separate [Element Bonus] On Leave 'return banished Slimes' clause (leaveFieldAbilities['f0ymeslfpw:0'] -> SlimeKingLeaveStart()) is consequently unreachable with nothing ever banished by this card, and is out of scope here.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate this card, banish three Slime ally cards each with different elements from your graveyard.

No SlimeKingCostBanish decision (Custom/GameLogic.php ~4347, a fully-written and otherwise-correct-looking handler) is ever queued, and the card materializes successfully with the graveyard untouched and nothing banished. Root cause confirmed by direct source reading: the cost-declaration function's $hasSlimeKingCost flag (declared false at ~line 2430, alongside dozens of sibling $hasXCost flags for other cards) is never set true anywhere in the file -- there is no CardID-gated branch analogous to Furnace Drone's (~line 2767) that would trigger the SlimeKingCostBanish decision chain. The card's own legality gate (activateCardPrereqs, requiring >=3 differently-elemented graveyard Slime allies to even play the card) is correctly wired; only the cost-CHARGING wiring was omitted.
